extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers and scientific review officers (SROs) using eRA Commons
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for reviewers and scientific review officers to run and participate in Internet Assisted Review (IAR) virtual meetings via eRA Commons, including where to find documentation, updates, FAQs, and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of IAR
rubrics_metrics.description: A high-level overview of the Internet Assisted Review (IAR) module, including its purpose, its key features and benefits as well as additional resources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand the module's purpose, key features, benefits, and what additional resources are available before using the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Virtual Meeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual Meeting, accessed through the Internet Assisted Review (IAR) module via eRA Commons, allows reviewers and scientific review officers to participate in an online review meeting in lieu of a face-to-face meeting at a physical location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Virtual Meeting capability as an alternative to in-person meetings; ensure access through IAR in eRA Commons and that participants (reviewers and SROs) are prepared to join virtually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Help
rubrics_metrics.description: Online user documentation for the Internet Assisted Review (IAR) module, including screenshots and step-by-step instructions. This information can also be accessed by clicking the question marks on the module’s screens
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the online help for procedural steps and visual guidance; use the in-module question-mark links for context-sensitive assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Guide (PDF)
rubrics_metrics.description: A PDF version of the online help, useful for those who would like to print the entire help
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download or print the PDF user guide when a complete, offline or hard-copy reference is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Features & Updates
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest changes and updates to the module
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the Features & Updates section regularly to stay informed about recent changes, bug fixes, or new functionality that may affect meeting workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequently asked questions about the module
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FAQ collection to resolve common issues and questions before contacting support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Video tutorials, presentations and other training resources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete available video tutorials and review presentations to familiarize yourself with IAR workflows and best practices prior to participating in virtual review meetings.
